service.name: Private party entertainment in Denver
service.serviceType: Live music for dinner parties, cocktail parties and milestone celebrations
service.description: Live music for Denver private parties at home and at the city's venues, solo through quartet, with sound support that's the right size for the space.

faqs.q: Can a band fit in a Denver house?
faqs.a: Yes, at the right size. A solo takes about 6 by 4 feet and one dedicated 20-amp circuit, sets up in 45 minutes and packs down in 30; a duo wants 8 by 6 feet, the same single circuit and an hour. That's the whole ask: a corner of the main floor, an outlet not shared with the kitchen, and a door we can carry through. Signet Artists books party musicians across Denver.

faqs.q: How loud is it at dinner?
faqs.a: About the level of the conversation at the table, so nobody raises their voice. Sets run 45 to 60 minutes with music through the breaks, so the party never goes quiet.
Setup at a Denver house is mostly a parking question. Tell us the block and which door is ours, alley, driveway or front walk, and we arrive with the smallest setup the night allows.

faqs.q: Do you charge travel inside Denver?
faqs.a: No. Travel lines start outside the metro: one short line covers the Front Range, and the mountain lines work the same way. Inside Denver there's no travel line, and sound is included at every size.
